name: D10 Dashamsa Career Rules
description: D10 detailed interpretation rules for career, profession, status, and authority
overview: The 10th harmonic (D10) = divisions of 30° into 10 parts of 3°. Shows career destiny, professional life, authority, public image, father.

rules.name: Lagna in D10
rules.interpretation: Lagna lord in D10 = professional identity, career aptitude
rules.weak: Debilitated = career struggles, lack of authority

rules.name: 10th House in D10
rules.interpretation: Shows actual profession, job satisfaction, reputation

rules.name: Amatya Karaka (AK)
rules.ak_sign: AK's sign in D10 = career field
rules.ak_placement: AK in 10th = powerful career; AK in 6/8/12 = challenges

rules.name: 10th Lord in D10
rules.strong_10l: Exalted/own house = high position, respect, wealth

rules.name: Saturn in D10
rules.interpretation: Hard work, perseverance, responsibility in career
rules.strong: Saturn in 10th D10 = slow but steady rise, mastery through discipline
rules.weak: Saturn in 6/8/12 = job loss, penalties, public humiliation

rules.name: Promotions & Authority
indicators: Sun in D10 Lagna or 10th = steady promotions
Saturn in own house/exaltation = respect, stability

sign_career_types.Capricorn: Mining, agriculture, government, administration, hard labor
sign_career_types.Aquarius: Science, technology, aviation, invention, social work
sign_career_types.Pisces: Spirituality, poetry, music, psychology, chemical industry
